svg.aria-label: MING mark: eight squares, four pillars over stems and branches
svg.title: MING — eight-square mark (brand-neutral)
svg.desc: 4 x 2 grid. Columns are the four pillars read right to left: year, month, day, hour. Top row heavenly stems, bottom row earthly branches. All squares ink except the day-pillar stem, which is cinnabar and means "you are here". Never redraw, recolour, round, outline, or animate this mark. A personal mark replaces every square with that chart's phase colour and uses no ink.
